notes: Google is the dominant VENDOR_MAKER of agentic/AI coding tools (Gemini CLI, Antigravity, Jules, Gemini Code Assist) AND a heavy internal DOGFOODER (monorepo AI codegen behind Pichai's >25% stat, Cider/Critique, Goose/Gemini-for-Google, AlphaEvolve). The clearest internal-usage signals are: the Pichai >25% new-code-AI-generated earnings quote (Q3 2024), AlphaEvolve's quantified infrastructure deployment (~0.7% compute recovered), and Cider/Critique AI features. Reporting indicates Google engineers are restricted to internal tools and discouraged/prohibited from using unapproved THIRD-PARTY agentic tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Codex), so no internal third-party-tool usage was evidenced. Where Antigravity exposes Anthropic/OpenAI models, that is a product feature for external developers, not internal Google engineering use. WebFetch was blocked (403) so usage details derive from WebSearch summaries; all URLs are real and appeared in search results.
